controls.title: Limit system access to authorized users
controls.description: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices (including other information systems).

controls.title: Limit system access to types of transactions and functions
controls.description: Limit information system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.

controls.title: Provide privacy and security notices
controls.description: Provide privacy and security notices consistent with CUI rules consistent with guidance in NIST SP 800-171 before establishing a user session.

controls.title: Limit access to CUI on system media
controls.description: Limit access to CUI on system media to authorized users.

controls.title: Employ principle of least privilege
controls.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific duties and information systems privileges.

controls.title: Use non-privileged accounts for non-security functions
controls.description: Use non-privileged accounts or roles when accessing non-security functions.

controls.title: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions
controls.description: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions and capture the execution of such functions in audit logs.

controls.title: Use session lock
controls.description: Use session lock with pattern-hiding displays after a period of inactivity and automatically terminate sessions after a defined condition.

controls.title: Authorize wireless access
controls.description: Authorize wireless access prior to allowing such connections and employ authentication and encryption for wireless access.

controls.title: Monitor and control remote access sessions
controls.description: Monitor and control remote access sessions and employ cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions.

controls.title: Route remote access via managed access control points
controls.description: Route remote access via managed network access control points.

controls.title: Control the flow of CUI
controls.description: Control the flow of CUI in accordance with approved authorizations.

controls.title: Separate duties of individuals
controls.description: Separate the duties of individuals to reduce the risk of malevolent activity without collusion.

controls.title: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions (advanced)
controls.description: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions and log all privileged function executions in audit logs with user attribution.

controls.title: Create and retain audit records
controls.description: Create and retain system audit logs and records to the extent needed to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity.

controls.title: Ensure audit events are traceable to users
controls.description: Ensure that the actions of individual system users can be uniquely traced to those users, so they can be held accountable for their actions.

controls.title: Review and update logged audit events
controls.description: Review and update logged events to include authentication failures, access control violations, privileged account use, and account changes.

controls.title: Alert on audit logging failure
controls.description: Alert in the event of an audit logging process failure and take remedial action.

controls.title: Correlate audit records from multiple sources
controls.description: Correlate audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes for investigation and response to indications of unlawful, unauthorized, suspicious, or unusual activity.

controls.title: Provide audit reduction and report generation
controls.description: Provide audit record reduction and report generation to support on-demand analysis and reporting.

controls.title: Periodically assess security controls
controls.description: Periodically assess the security controls in organizational systems to determine if the controls are effective in their application.

controls.title: Develop and implement plans of action
controls.description: Develop and implement plans of action designed to correct deficiencies and reduce or eliminate vulnerabilities in organizational systems.

controls.title: Monitor security controls on an ongoing basis
controls.description: Monitor security controls on an ongoing basis to ensure the continued effectiveness of the controls.

controls.title: Conduct penetration testing
controls.description: Periodically conduct penetration testing to evaluate the security of organizational systems.

controls.title: Employ independent assessors
controls.description: Employ independent assessors or assessment teams to monitor security controls with a level of independence appropriate to the system impact level.

controls.title: Establish and maintain baseline configurations
controls.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of organizational systems (including hardware, software, firmware, and documentation) throughout the respective system development life cycles.

controls.title: Establish and enforce security configuration settings
controls.description: Establish and enforce security configuration settings for information technology products employed in organizational systems.

controls.title: Define, document, approve, and enforce physical and logical access restrictions
controls.description: Establish and enforce access restrictions associated with changes to organizational systems.

controls.title: Restrict, disable, or prevent use of nonessential programs
controls.description: Restrict, disable, or prevent the use of nonessential programs, functions, ports, protocols, and services.

controls.title: Identify system users, processes, and devices
controls.description: Identify information system users, processes acting on behalf of users, or devices.

controls.title: Authenticate identities before allowing access
controls.description: Authenticate (or verify) the identities of those users, processes, or devices, as a prerequisite to allowing access to organizational systems.

controls.title: Employ replay-resistant authentication
controls.description: Employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for network access to privileged and non-privileged accounts.

controls.title: Employ MFA for network access to non-privileged accounts
controls.description: Employ multifactor authentication for network access to non-privileged accounts.

controls.title: Employ MFA for local access to privileged accounts
controls.description: Employ multifactor authentication for local access to privileged accounts.

controls.title: Employ password length and complexity requirements
controls.description: Enforce a minimum password complexity and change of characters when new passwords are created.

controls.title: Prohibit password reuse
controls.description: Prohibit password reuse for a specified number of generations.

controls.title: Use multifactor authentication for local and network access
controls.description: Use multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts.

controls.title: Employ physical authenticators
controls.description: Employ physical authenticators (e.g., FIDO2 hardware tokens, PIV cards) for privileged account access.

controls.title: Establish an operational incident-handling capability
controls.description: Establish an operational incident-handling capability for organizational systems that includes preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response activities.

controls.title: Track, document, and report incidents
controls.description: Track, document, and report incidents to designated officials and/or authorities both internal and external to the organization.

controls.title: Test incident response capability
controls.description: Test the organizational incident response capability.

controls.title: Develop and implement response plans
controls.description: Develop and implement response plans that provide the details for incident response operations.

controls.title: Perform root cause analysis
controls.description: Perform a root cause analysis of security incidents and use findings to update incident response procedures.

controls.title: Track and analyze incident trends
controls.description: Track, analyze, and use information about cyber threats and indicators of compromise to inform decisions about incident detection, containment, eradication, and recovery.

controls.title: Perform maintenance on organizational systems
controls.description: Perform maintenance on organizational systems. Provide controls on the tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel that conduct system maintenance.

controls.title: Provide controls on maintenance tools
controls.description: Provide controls on the tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel that conduct system maintenance.

controls.title: Ensure equipment is sanitized prior to removal
controls.description: Ensure equipment removed for off-site maintenance is sanitized of any CUI.

controls.title: Protect system media containing CUI, both paper and digital
controls.description: Protect (i.e., physically control and securely store) system media containing CUI, both paper and digital.

controls.title: Limit access to CUI on system media to authorized users
controls.description: Limit access to CUI on system media to authorized users.

controls.title: Control the use of removable media on system components
controls.description: Control the use of removable media on system components.

controls.title: Sanitize or destroy system media before disposal
controls.description: Sanitize or destroy system media before disposal or reuse.

controls.title: Mark media with necessary CUI markings and distribution limitations
controls.description: Mark media with necessary CUI markings and distribution limitations.

controls.title: Prohibit the use of portable storage without identifiable owner
controls.description: Prohibit the use of portable storage devices when such devices have no identifiable owner.

controls.title: Limit physical access to authorized individuals
controls.description: Limit physical access to organizational information systems, equipment, and the respective operating environments to authorized individuals.

controls.title: Escort visitors and monitor visitor activity
controls.description: Escort visitors and monitor visitor activity; maintain audit logs of physical access.

controls.title: Control and manage physical access devices
controls.description: Control and manage physical access devices.

controls.title: Enforce safeguarding measures for CUI at alternate work sites
controls.description: Enforce safeguarding measures for CUI at alternate work sites.

controls.title: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to systems
controls.description: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to organizational systems containing CUI.

controls.title: Ensure CUI is protected during and after personnel actions
controls.description: Ensure that organizational systems containing CUI are protected during and after personnel actions such as terminations and transfers.

controls.title: Periodically assess risk to operations
controls.description: Periodically assess the risk to organizational operations, organizational assets, and individuals, resulting from the operation of organizational systems and the associated processing, storage, or transmission of CUI.

controls.title: Scan for vulnerabilities periodically
controls.description: Periodically scan organizational systems and applications for vulnerabilities and remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with risk assessments.

controls.title: Remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with risk assessments
controls.description: Remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with risk assessments.

controls.title: Periodically perform risk assessments (advanced)
controls.description: Periodically perform risk assessments using a formal risk assessment methodology and document the results.

controls.title: Analyze the effectiveness of security solutions
controls.description: Analyze the effectiveness of security solutions at least annually to address anticipated risks to the system.

controls.title: Receive cyber threat intelligence
controls.description: Receive cyber threat intelligence, including indicators of compromise, from information sharing forums and organizations.

controls.title: Monitor, control, and protect organizational communications
controls.description: Monitor, control, and protect organizational communications (i.e., information transmitted or received by organizational information systems) at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of the information systems.

controls.title: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components
controls.description: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal networks.

controls.title: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography for CUI
controls.description: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI.

controls.title: Implement cryptographic mechanisms for CUI transmission
controls.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of CUI during transmission unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards.

controls.title: Identify, report, and correct information system flaws
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct information and information system flaws in a timely manner.

controls.title: Provide protection from malicious code
controls.description: Provide protection from malicious code at appropriate locations within organizational information systems.

controls.title: Monitor system security alerts
controls.description: Monitor information system security alerts and advisories and take appropriate actions in response.

controls.title: Update malicious code protection mechanisms
controls.description: Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available.

controls.title: Perform periodic scans of organizational systems
controls.description: Perform periodic scans of organizational systems and real-time scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed.

controls.title: Establish a supply chain risk management process
controls.description: Establish a supply chain risk management process, including addressing security risks associated with information and communications technology products and services throughout the system development life cycle.

controls.title: Identify and assess supply chain risks
controls.description: Identify and assess risks to organizational systems and organizations associated with supply chain risk assessment and apply mitigations based on risk assessment.

controls.title: Manage supply chain risks from external systems services
controls.description: Manage risks associated with the use of externally provided information systems or services.

controls.title: Employ safe disposal of system components
controls.description: Employ safe disposal procedures and verification that system components are disposed of properly to prevent unauthorized disclosure of CUI.
